claim: In 1921, on April 25, Albert Einstein and Warren Harding were with a group at the White House, Washington, D.C.

evidence.quote: item.title: [Albert Einstein, Warren Harding and group at White House, Washington, D.C.]
cite_this.chicago: Harding, Prof. Einstein & wife, 4/25/21. , 1921. [April 25] Photograph.

notes: Journey pin fact for the Washington room built only from LoC photograph records (no manual newspaper snapshot). The White House and the group come from the Harris & Ewing record (dated [between 1921 and 1923]); the day comes from the National Photo Company negative of Harding and Einstein, which LoC dates 4/25/21 and cites as '1921. [April 25]'. That the two negatives show the same occasion is an inference for the adversary and reviewer to judge; the Evening Star of April 25, 1921 (EIN-F-0090) reports the White House reception that day.
